verdict.rationale: Unleash documents environments as separate lifecycle stages, so a flag can be enabled in development or test without enabling it in production. Backend tokens are scoped to a single environment, change requests can gate production changes, and a self-hosted Docker deployment allows a fully separate instance. Together these give a clear way to test without affecting production. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/trial-instance offering, evidence that agent tooling (e.g., the MCP server) can be confined to non-production environments, and independent hands-on corroboration.
